title: Negotiate SaaS agreement
summary: Create a standard SaaS subscription agreement, terms of service, and privacy policy.

parts.title: Draft SaaS agreement template
parts.guidance: Draft around the actual service, customers and commercial model. Resolve choices for fees, renewal, support, data handling, liability, suspension and termination with the relevant business and legal reviewers. Reconcile the agreement with order forms, service levels and processing schedules. Keep unagreed terms visible and tie service commitments to the product being sold.

parts.title: Draft Terms of Service
parts.guidance: Write terms for the actual account and purchase flow: contracting entity, audience, billing, acceptable use, termination and how users encounter and accept them. Check factual behavior with product and commercial teams. Identify conflicts with negotiated enterprise terms and send unresolved legal choices for review alongside the proposed acceptance flow.

parts.title: Draft Privacy Policy
parts.guidance: Describe the service’s data flows through account creation, billing, support, analytics and customer content. Distinguish processing for the company’s own purposes from processing for customers. Check retention, sharing and deletion statements against implementation, and identify unresolved facts for the relevant teams. Review the resulting notice with the rest of the contracting package.

parts.title: Legal counsel review
parts.guidance: Review the agreement, website terms, privacy notice, order forms and schedules together with counsel. Resolve conflicting promises and confirm technical claims with product or security specialists. Agree negotiation fallback terms and escalation points with the business owner. Give sales and product the final versions and the conditions under which a further review is needed.

parts.title: Publish to website
parts.guidance: Release the approved public documents at the intended signup, checkout and account locations. Verify links, mobile rendering, versions and the acceptance record captured by the flow. Keep negotiated customer agreements in the contract repository. Preserve the published release so later product or pricing changes can be compared with the terms users actually saw.

geoNotes.summary: German AGB law subjects standard terms to content control EVEN B2B (§§ 305-310 BGB): liability caps and auto-renewal clauses that are routine in US SaaS paper are regularly void here — localize the template, don't just translate it.

metadata.supportReason: System can draft initial templates using company context. Legal review and customer-specific negotiations are person-routed.
